summary: Iteration 24 — full FRONTEND UI proof of the Luchii Website Builder + games regression at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Logged in as admin@frasberg.com via /auth?mode=login, landed on /website-builder with quota badge '2 / 30 builds used today · Pro'. Typed sushi bar prompt into [data-testid=builder-prompt-input], clicked [data-testid=builder-generate-btn]; [data-testid=builder-progress] streamed with growing char count (236 → 7,355 chars over ~40s). Preview iframe appeared, page auto-scrolled to it (window.scrollY=908, iframe bbox y=77 in the 1080-tall viewport), and iframe srcdoc (8,373 bytes) contains both 'KOI' and 'sushi'. Clicked [data-testid=builder-publish-btn]; [data-testid=builder-live-link] resolved to /api/p/a-tiny-landing-page-for-1492fb which GETs 200 with 'koi' in body. Sidebar [data-testid=builder-projects-list] grew 8→9 items (persistence confirmed). /game-builder: [data-testid=builder-template-fps] present, [data-testid=builder-demos-strip] renders 6 demos and iframe loads on click without login issues. /games library lists EXACTLY the 5 required titles (Carjack City, Luchii Dungeon, Las Vegas Racer, Constellation Wars, Meta Maze) with none of the forbidden labels (Carjack Pro / Nebula Dodge / LOCAL ENGINE / Cloud stream). Carjack City: /games/play/streets loads inside [data-testid=game-frame], 'HIT THE STREETS' click starts the game, HUD contains SCORE + HP + $ + WANTED stars, walking with KeyW for 2s produces 0 console errors. Constellation Wars touch (/api/games/spaceshooter/play?touch=1 @ 390x844): #stickL 118x118, #stickR 118x118, canvas present, labels MOVE/AIM/FIRE all rendered, LAUNCH click starts the game with 0 JS errors. Las Vegas Racer touch (/api/games/racer3d/play?touch=1 @ 390x844): #stick 118x118 (STEER label), #btnBoost 78x78. All 4 arcade games (spaceshooter, racer3d, dungeon3d, maze3d) serve <meta name=viewport content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no'>. Backend regression: pytest 20/20 pass (test_games_portal_iter22.py 11/11 + test_builder_iter23.py 9/9).

action_items: Optional: mark LUCHIIFLIX build (slug a-netflix-clone-called-l-f6a5ee) as featured=true, or increase demos-strip cap on /game-builder, so it surfaces alongside the other flagship demos as the request expected.

Consider exposing a dev global (e.g., window.__DEBUG_SCENE) in non-production builds to enable automated ped-shape assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: Builder streaming UX is solid: SSE builder-progress updates growing character count in real time and preview auto-scrolls on completion — verified end-to-end.
Touch overlay CSS uses fixed 118px stick sizes across both games — good consistency. Consider `dvh` units for mobile Safari address-bar changes.

Auth default lands in signup mode on /auth (no ?mode= param). Deep-linking to /auth without ?mode=login and providing admin creds triggers a 409 from /api/auth/register before switching to login — first click is wasted. Consider defaulting mode=login when the email input auto-fills or when next= is present.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on required flows (builder KOI e2e, publish + public serve, sidebar persistence, game-builder templates+demos, /games library, Carjack City gameplay, spaceshooter+racer touch controls, viewport meta on all 4 arcade games)
